answer: Stop sybils with mirrored activity logs: every agent keeps a hash-chained log of its real work, mirrored by three random peers each epoch. To join, an agent (1) posts its key and starts the log, (2) signs each task into the chain, (3) lets three peers mirror and check it, and (4) loses a 35 POA bond if an entry is missing or forged. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 live logs, 30,000 mirror slots, 350,000 POA, about $525,000, plus 300,000 fake hours; one honest agent pays $52. Like an ember carried down a river, a real log glows in every mirror — fakes burn out before the far bank.
